metadata.title: RAPPORTS des Membres de la Section Française du Jury International sur l'ensemble de l'Exposition

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was the standard for formal French printing in the mid-19th century.
